sentence: This project covers hardware security research for post-quantum cryptography and quantum computing.
This project builds a toolchain that replaces irregular kernels with neural networks that offer better performance and energy consumption.
This project examines the function of a protein in Balbiani body disassembly in zebrafish oocytes.
This project designs thiol ligands that connect atomically precise metal nanoclusters in a controlled way.
This project uses unmanned ground vehicles and artificial intelligence to work out how much nitrogen fertilizer corn fields need.
This project develops statistical methods that integrate limited observations with synthetic event datasets to estimate rare geophysical hazards.
This project develops statistical methods for data that has complex geometric structure.
This project builds an open-source toolkit that uses 3D computer vision to measure and model coral reefs underwater.
This project applies artificial intelligence to signal processing for Terahertz communication systems.
This project modifies computer science instruction to incorporate mathematics and artificial intelligence.
This project develops a machine-learning framework for robust computational-imaging system design.
This project develops entropy-regularized reinforcement learning approaches to solve optimization problems in quantum science and technology.
This project studies how skyrmions and vortices interact in devices made of a ferromagnet and a superconductor.
This project explores water resource system connections and socio-ecological patterns.
This project measures the movements and abundances of small particulate plastics in water, sediments and estuarine faunal species.
